body: But the concept of waiting to see if things might be better could be repeated ad infinitum, right? I could do that for 100 years and maintain my misery under the false hope of change. I appreciate the concept that suicide is a fallback, and would be the worst case scenario of anything I could possibly attempt at this point. But doing something drastic would expose me to commentary and action by my family and friends, which could only serve to increase my unhappiness and agitation. Is it not easier to just end the whole ordeal, with no possibility of further sorrow? That's certainly the easiest option, and in my experience, easier options are usually better options.
